UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private student profile storing the confirmed phone number entered after login.

phoneNumber.description: Phone number entered by the student to confirm item lending and borrowing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

CampusItem.title: CampusItem
CampusItem.description: An item shared by a student for other signed-in students across devices.

description.description: Short note or pickup details for the shared item.

photoUrl.description: Compressed JPEG data URL photo of the shared item.

category.description: Category label shown on the item card.

visibility.description: Campus visibility scope used for scoped list queries.

authorId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who added the item.

authorName.description: Display name of the student who added the item.

authorPhone.description: Confirmed pickup phone number of the student sharing the item.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the item was last updated.

CampusRequest.title: CampusRequest
CampusRequest.description: A shared student request visible to all signed-in users with atomic Open -> Accepted -> Fulfilled lifecycle.

description.description: What item the student needs and pickup details.

itemId.description: Optional linked shared item ID, or null for general requests.

itemTitle.description: Optional linked shared item title, or null.

itemPhotoUrl.description: Optional linked shared item photo URL, or null.

visibility.description: Campus visibility scope used for scoped list queries.

requesterId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requesting student.

requesterName.description: Display name of the requesting student.

requesterPhone.description: Confirmed phone number of the requesting student.

acceptedById.description: Firebase Auth UID of the accepting student, or null while Open.

acceptedByName.description: Display name of the accepting student, or null while Open.

acceptedByPhone.description: Confirmed phone number of the accepting student, or null while Open.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the request was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private student profile storing confirmed phone numbers.

/campusItems/{itemId}.description: Shared items visible to all signed-in users across devices.

/campusRequests/{requestId}.description: Shared student requests with atomic acceptance and fulfillment tracking.
